title: TEHRAN – October 8, 2026 – Mohammad Eslami, head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran made remarks in an interview.
text:
TEHRAN – October 8, 2026 – Mohammad Eslami, head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran made remarks in an interview."

""

"SOT, Mohammad Eslami, head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (Farsi): "The Agency [IAEA] itself knows that in places where missile barrages have occurred and active threats exist, where we are being threatened every day and our facilities have been targeted, it is natural that visits are not possible. They do not have the means to conduct investigations. Furthermore, parliamentary law does not allow us to cooperate with the Agency due to two issues; one is, in fact, national security; the security of our staff and researchers, because as long as security is not established, it is naturally impossible for them to enter. However, in locations other than the targeted centers, the Agency has come to conduct inspections and carry out its routine work according to the arrangements made. Unfortunately, they do not mention these. Those who are under pressure from the United States and Israel to come and uncover things, or to complete the task of providing information to them, are agents backed by those same Zionists and Americans who exert pressure, and they will not achieve their goal.”
